CLOUD FIXER seat for roster group R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (round 3; your PR is #2609, head a0520623a31dd50ca07e3a4067e42e32b3b13554). Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own at the existing code tip `git fetch origin handoff/r10-arch-docs-first` (122381f55), merging origin/main in if it has moved.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-arch-docs-first, then write the PR body (headings per .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-arch-docs-first <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-arch-docs-first. That second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 3 of R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST. PR #2609 is open at a0520623 (your code 122381f55 plus a merge of main 6c8903a44). The owner wants it merged and stamped ASAP. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 for every prepr/gate run.
CI is red at a0520623, and the cause is structural, not a slip: .github/workflows/governance.yml step "Restore the check source from the base commit" (decision 0013) checks out tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs, tools/policy/agreement.mjs and the rest of its pinned list FROM THE BASE before running. A PR cannot change its own checker. So your round-2 resolveCited canon lookup and your SHARED_GRAMMARS entry are never run on this PR. CI ran main's copies:
- policy-docs (required), job 119791595301: `[named-docs] dev/README.md: is named by .claude/rules/ratchet-budgets.md but has no cap ...`.
- env-matrix, job 119791595403: `pr / policy_lint rc=0 and every pin earned -- rc=1 pins=246`. The base lint cannot earn your 247th pin, and the push-main and no-remote arms fail the same way.
- wave-script, job 119791595043: `UNREGISTERED "[\\w.-]+(?:/[\\w.-]+)+/?" in tests/doc_claims.py, tests/entities.py`; AGREEMENT REFUSED.
- pr-contract: `## Red checks` does not name wave-script. This follows from the others.
DECISION O-5 (orchestrator, under mandate 6329234399, scope all):
1. Agreement: do not register the grammar. Remove the duplication instead. tests/doc_claims.py predicate (a) uses the one path-token grammar tests/entities.py already defines (`_sp_path_literal`'s), imported or moved to one shared definition both read, whichever is sounder. Then the grammar exists once, and agreement under the base passes with no agreement.mjs change. Revert your tools/policy/agreement.mjs edit.
2. named-docs: take the pre-approved FALLBACK, payment 1. Add one dev/governance/config/corpus_excluded.json (or wherever CORPUS_EXCLUDED lives; find it) entry for dev/README.md, reason "developer onboarding, not policy; it defers to CLAUDE.md". Payment 2 is measured unable to clear this under decision 0013's base pin. Record it under `## Raise justification`: payment 2 tried, the refusal quoted, why it cannot land in this PR, and an `Architecture score: dS` line from tools/audit/archscore/ run before and after.
3. Split your tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs canon lookup and its 247th pin OUT of this PR: revert both here. The canon lookup is sound and is the real removal of the cause, so it goes forward as a Forward-carry to R10-ARCH-DOCS (the round's last stage, `after` this group): "land policy_lint.mjs resolveCited canon lookup + its pin as its own PR (decision 0013 pins the checker from base), then drop dev/README.md's corpus_excluded entry". Keep the D9.md citation correction. It is plain text, not a checker, and correct on its own.
4. Before pushing, reproduce CI's lane LOCALLY, never only your head's tools. In a scratch worktree at your head, `git checkout origin/main -- tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs tools/policy/agreement.mjs` (plus anything else in that step's pinned list you touched), then run node tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs, node tools/policy/agreement.mjs (with its py-json step as the workflow runs it) and the env-matrix driver. Each must be clean. Put the commands and RESULT lines in the body's Figures. A null control re-introduces the duplicate grammar and the UNREGISTERED line returns.
5. Merge origin/main in, re-run prepr, re-take EVERY figure, and rewrite the whole body (body-staleness rule). Drop the "Policy edits under mandate" claims about policy_lint.mjs. List policy_lint.mjs and agreement.mjs as no longer touched under hot files. `## Red checks` names wave-script, policy-docs and env-matrix at a0520623, with the cause (base-pinned checker) and the answer: the cheaper detector is running the base-pinned lane locally in prepr. Check whether tools/pr/prepr already does that. If it does not, carry it to R10-ORCH-MACHINERY with a Carry line.
Return on handoff/r10-arch-docs-first (code) and handoff-body/r10-arch-docs-first (body), as before. Do not push the PR branch yourself: the orchestrator runs update_pr.sh.
Time box 60 min.
